en: Auditaxes International LLP is an international association composed of legally separate, independently owned and managed firms providing accounting, audit, tax, consulting and other professional services. Each member firm is a distinct legal entity and is solely responsible for the professional services it provides, its client relationships, and compliance with the laws, regulations and professional standards applicable in the jurisdictions in which it operates.

Auditaxes International LLP does not provide professional services directly to clients and assumes no responsibility or liability for the acts, omissions, services, obligations or liabilities of its member firms. No member firm has the authority to bind or commit Auditaxes International LLP or any other member firm, and Auditaxes International LLP has no authority to bind or commit any of its member firms.

The manuals, templates, guides, illustrative materials, tools, training programs and other resources provided by Auditaxes International LLP have been developed for the purpose of supporting member firms in the application of professional standards and best practices. These materials are intended for guidance purposes and do not replace professional judgment, applicable legal or regulatory requirements, or current professional standards.

Where appropriate, such materials must be adapted to the particular circumstances of each jurisdiction, firm, client or professional engagement. Member firms and individual users are responsible for remaining current with applicable standards, evaluating the relevance and sufficiency of the materials used, and ensuring that the work performed is appropriate to the circumstances and properly documented where required.

Some of the information, materials and tools available on this website may have been prepared or provided by member firms of Auditaxes International. Although such information is provided in good faith, Auditaxes International LLP and the relevant member firms do not warrant that it is complete, accurate, current or suitable for all circumstances and accept no responsibility or liability for any decisions, actions, omissions, losses or consequences arising from its use.

Materials and tools developed by Auditaxes International LLP may originally be available in the English language. Translations into other languages may be prepared by member firms or other contributors. Auditaxes International LLP does not necessarily verify the accuracy, completeness or consistency of such translations with the original documents. In the event of any discrepancy, the relevant original version should be consulted.

The information contained on this website and in the materials made available through it is general in nature and does not constitute accounting, audit, tax, legal, financial, investment or any other form of professional advice. Appropriate professional advice should be obtained based on the particular circumstances before making decisions or taking action in reliance on such information.

Auditaxes International LLP and its member firms accept no responsibility or liability for the use, interpretation or application of the information, materials, tools or translations available on this website, except to the extent that such liability cannot be excluded under applicable law.
